evidence: GET /wp-json/wp/v2/product?per_page=1 -> x-wp-total: 2809 (anon, status defaults to publish)
GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1&stock_status[]=instock&stock_status[]=outofstock -> x-wp-total: 2809 (matches exactly)
Sitemap union (product-sitemap.xml + 2.xml + 3.xml) = 1001+1000+808 = 2809 (matches exactly)
WC Store API default (stock_status=instock only) = 1577 - confirms R1's denominator is in-stock-only
DB's 2756 is stale (2026-04-11); live count grew by 53 products
corrections.rationale: WP REST default returns all published products. Three independent counts (WP REST, WC Store API w/ combined stock filter, sitemap union) all return 2809 exactly. R1 incorrectly chose in-stock-only denominator; DB had correct semantics but stale value.

evidence: WC Store API default filters by stock_status=instock unless combined param explicitly set, yielding wrong denominator (1577 vs 2809)

corrections.rationale: Endpoint must yield the full denominator to match crawler watermark semantics. DB endpoint is correct; R1's choice silently undercounts by 1232 OOS products.

R1's defensive 'when unsure set true' is the wrong call when the operational reality is clean. DB's false matches runtime behavior.
